title: Kay M NDE 889
content:
My friend told me she could make me pass out. I, being a naive eight or nine year old didn't believe her. She dared me to let her try and I went ahead with it not believing anything would happen. She had me lean over and breath really fast, she stood behind me and squeezed my stomach really tight. The next thing I remember is being in a void. Then all around me almost as if I were one with them, were colors. More than are here on earth and a feeling of peace. I felt like I was surrounded by love, comfort and peace. I also heard music but not like we hear it here. It seemed as one with the colors. I felt like I understood this all and wanted to stay. Then a sad feeling and I opened my eyes to my friends staring with very worried looks on their faces. They said it had taken a long time for me to wake up. It felt like only a few minutes to me. After this experience I felt I could understand a lot of adult emotional situations even though I hadn't had the life experience to yet account for this. As an adult, I usually instantly know people's true personalities even when I don't care to know. This has been ever since I have had this experience as a child. I don't know what to call this but I'll never forget it.

environment.environment_other_detail: Music 'not like we hear it here' that 'seemed as one with the colors.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Intentional fainting induced by rapid breathing and a friend squeezing her stomach tightly.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Void; immersion in colors; sense of peace/love/comfort; unusual music blended with colors; desire to stay; sadness; return to waking with friends worried.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Loss of consciousness followed by being in a void and experiencing colors/music/peace, then waking back in the body; no OBE, tunnel, beings, life review, or boundary described.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Colors and music were experienced as 'one with' each other, alongside peace/love/comfort.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Music experienced as integrated with colors ('It seemed as one with the colors.').
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The next thing I remember is being in a void. Then all around me almost as if I were one with them, were colors. More than are here on earth and a feeling of peace.”
